challenge.results: The v3.29.0 tag targets the exact commit serving the entry. The plain exception text says “GNU General Public License.” The SPDX template makes “ Lesser” optional, and its HTML marks that word optional. HACKING §9.5 actually prints “GNU Lesser General Public License.” The generated plain text therefore corresponds to §9.4 even though the SPDX template also accommodates the wording difference in §9.5. Neither seeAlso reference identifies HACKING as SPDX’s cited source.

limitations: The finding concerns documentary correspondence at the named release. It establishes neither byte equality nor a formal SPDX template match.
